verdict.rationale: Privacy posture around training-data use is a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence pack never documents a training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any related ADK control. Support for locally running models and offline deployment are adjacent arrangements a user could make; they are not a documented ADK capability for preventing training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
